additional_info.subject: ID0441324-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004765] Issue with Charging process CRM:02684000457
additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising this issue. We are currently looking for the root cause of this incident.
At first, we see that the vehicle, while stopping the session, is creating a negative voltage on our system and the LEM meter provides a error that causes the meterstop = meterstart.
As soon as we have news, we will convey them to you.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0441324-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004765] Issue with Charging process CRM:02684000457
additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good afternoon.
This issue has been addressed by our development team and has a fix implemented in the FW v8.1. As soon as it's ready to be deployed, Johannes will reach out to you and do the update.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead!
Best regards,
Francisco
